weather_report:
Rottnest Island dozes under a woolen sky tonight, a lid of cloud that’s expected to linger through the small hours and into dawn. Sunshine will be scarce at first light; the UV sits near nil overnight and should stay modest early, only waking if the cloud slackens later. Expect a quiet, muted morning with flat, silvery light and softened horizons, clear enough to see by but short on sparkle.

Dress in light layers and comfortable shoes, a thin jacket for the cool pre-dawn breeze, and stash sunglasses and sunscreen in case the ceiling breaks toward midday. Just now, it’s a good hour for a slow wander along the settlement paths or to listen to the surf working in the dark. As the grey morning gathers, try a gentle roll along the bike paths, a shoreline amble to watch the pale day arrive, then linger over coffee or leaf through a book while the sky makes up its mind. Save the sun-chasing for later, if it shows.
